lessons.trigger_condition: V409 review confirmed that game/region focus and HOT cards reacted to verified market data, while the adaptive 18-feature layout still consumed only generic market/release/event activity through fixed formulas and the existing 17→12→18 screen neural inputs. The market-lens state itself did not provide a separate freshness-gated bounded policy contribution.
lessons.prevention_rule: Create a verified market-context adapter that converts only non-directional trade/release/event activity and dataset freshness into one of quiet, revalidate, mixed, trade, release or event attention states; allow at most +4% feature bias; combine it inside the existing ±8% total policy cap; zero the adapter when freshness is insufficient; preserve the existing 17→12→18 neural Champion/Challenger, drift hold and rollback gates; never use click behavior or infer price direction.
validation_required: market context uses only verified market_activity, release_activity, event_activity and dataset freshness
stale market context fails closed to revalidate with zero feature bias
market-context feature bias is capped at +0.04
combined learned plus market-context feature bias remains capped at ±0.08
existing screen neural remains 17 inputs, 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
dashboard exposes market context state without persisting user behavior
market direction and price direction remain uninferred
source generation, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V410 changes presentation-policy weighting only. It cannot invent price/grade/stock/release/event facts, infer market direction, rewrite source at runtime, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, persist precise location or user behavior, or bypass existing V399/V400/neural verification gates.
